text:
Maria: Heads up — BlueArc renewal is due 4/2. They want to consolidate billing across BlueArc US / EMEA / APAC under a single parent BU. Procurement says they can only process per-entity POs. Legal flagged a DPA addendum + a UK data-residency clause. Need a clear signature/invoice path. Thoughts?

Raj: Do we have contract id + ARR? Need to know if pricing/term change required.

Maria: Contract CID-7832, ARR $420k, renewal term 12m. They're asking for a 10% concession if we accept a single invoice across entities.

Nina: Finance needs full entity mapping + tax IDs. If procurement insists on separate POs we can accept split POs but must route invoices to different billing entities. Single invoice implies intercompany billing and treasury involvement.

Ben: Intercompany billing requires GL mapping and an intercompany memo. We can do consolidated invoice only if they provide parent-level PO and intercompany authorization. Otherwise split invoices is the fastest path.

Tom: Legal can draft a DPA addendum; estimated turnaround ~2 business days. For the UK clause we need to confirm hosting region and exact wording. Also need to know the signature matrix — who signs for parent vs each subsidiary?

Priya: To avoid getting stuck in legal loops, propose a two-step approach: (1) ask procurement whether a parent-level PO is acceptable; (2) if not, propose they issue three sub-POs but allow a single DocuSign envelope with delegated signers so onboarding/legal don't have to chase separate envelopes.

Diane: From onboarding perspective they prefer a single signer. We have a DocuSign template 'renewal-multi-entity' we can adapt with role 'ParentSigner' and optional 'EntityApprover' fields. If they insist on separate POs we can still send one envelope with multiple signers but that adds coordination time.

docusign-bot: Template renewal-multi-entity last updated 2025-03-10 by onboarding. Status: ready.

Raj: Pricing note — customer requested 10% for single invoice. I recommend counter 5% + 60-day payment terms. I can own negotiation and loop AE.

Maria: Action items: Raj to lead pricing counter; Nina/Ben to confirm finance feasibility for accepting parent invoice without full GL mapping; Tom/Priya to prepare DPA + delegated-signature DocuSign flow; Diane to prep DocuSign template and run a dry-run. Target: get signed by 3/28. @Ben @Nina please confirm feasibility by EOD.

Nina: I can confirm by EOD whether finance can accept parent-level invoice in principle, but GL mapping will take up to 5 business days if required.

Ben: Confirmed: we can accept a parent-level invoice only if the customer provides intercompany memo and parent PO. Otherwise we'll need split invoices per billing entity.

Maria: Thanks all. I'll ask the customer to attempt parent PO first and share procurement contact (emma.proc@bluearc.com). I'll loop them into this thread once they confirm. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
